facts.statement: Community Event in which Community Team Ambassadors hid inside Blackspore for players to find.
facts.quote: The Ambassadors are dressed in their costumes and have found great places to hide inside Blackspore.

facts.statement: After a player scares an Ambassador properly, the player sends a trade request to the Ambassador and receives a treat; a found Ambassador vanishes and reappears elsewhere.
facts.quote: After you scare them properly, send a trade request and you’ll get a treat!

facts.statement: Event ran on Server 1 on Thursday October 14, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America).
facts.quote: Thursday October 14th, 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: Second run on Server 1 on Friday October 15, 2010 at 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT for UK and Europe.
facts.quote: Friday October 15th, 2010 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

facts.statement: Ambassadors gave instructions and hints in the Zone Chat tab; players had to enable the 'Show Area Chat' option via the wrench icon in the lower left of the screen.
facts.quote: The Ambassadors will be using the ZONE CHAT tab in your chat window to give instructions and hints

facts.statement: A community event in which Community Team Ambassadors hide inside Blackspore (Esporaumbría) and players search high and low to find them.
facts.quote: Busca en lo alto y los suelos y cuando encuentres a uno de los embajadores, dales un susto.

facts.statement: After a player scares an Ambassador, the player sends it a trade request and is given a prize; the Ambassador then hides again in a new location.
facts.quote: después de asustarlos, envíales una solicitud para intercambiar y se te otorgara un premio

facts.statement: The Ambassadors hide inside Blackspore rather than outside it, and give clues and location codes through the Zone Chat channel.
facts.quote: Los Embajadores estarán usando la sección “Zona de Chat” en la ventanilla de chat para dar instrucciones y claves

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Ambassador Haunt and Seek
article_summaries.summary: A Community Team event in which Ambassadors hid inside Blackspore and players searched for them, scaring each one and then sending a trade request for a treat. The page gives two Server 1 run times (October 14 and 15, 2010) and says the Ambassadors give hints in Zone Chat. The exact post date is not shown; it is only given relative to the capture date.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Spanish-language community event: Posee y Busca a los Embajadores)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language freerealms.com post announcing a community event in which Community Team Ambassadors hide in Blackspore (Esporaumbría in the Spanish text) and players must find them, scare them, and request a trade for a prize. The article gives the event times for Server 1 for Pacific/Latin America and UK/Europe audiences, and explains that clues are posted in the Zone Chat channel and events are reached through the Game Guide calendar.
